scope: Synchronous invocation/Task-return observer semantics, existing whole-stage async completion, marker callback order/ownership. Fake controlled callbacks, no real-model or GPU timing qualification.

tdd.standalone_runner: Direct invocation of six NUnit methods on .NET 10, not Unity or GPU execution

invariants: Pending Task is returned by identity and submission scope ends before Task completion.
Original error is preserved even if end observer also fails; end failure after success is not hidden.
Failed begin does not invoke stage or end an unstarted scope; invalid arguments have no side effects.
Opt-in proxy emits submitting/submitted before async completed; default existing event semantics retained.
Borrowed stage/callback ownership and restore behavior remains covered by existing tests.
